question: Karishma Yadav was awarded the Vikram Award 2019 for ______ by the Government of Madhya Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **International hockey player Karishma Yadav** has received the **Vikram Award from the Madhya Pradesh government **for excellence in sports.
 
• **Chief Minister Shri Chouhan felicitated players and coaches with Vikram, Eklavya, Vishwamitra, and Lifetime Achievement Award** at **Madhya Pradesh Shikhar Khel Alankaran Samaroh 2019** in Minto Hall.
 
• Olympian hockey player** Shri Inam-ur-Rehman of Bhopal** was honoured with the Life Time Achievement Award of 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **For the year 2020, 13 Eklavya, 10 Vikram, 3 Vishwamitra, 1 Late Prabhash Joshi, and 1 Lifetime Achievement Award have been announced by the Madhya Pradesh government.**
 
• **The Lifetime Achievement Award for the year 2020 will be given to Padma Shri Abhay Chhajlani, while Olympic hockey player of the state Vivek Sagar will be awarded the state's best Vikram Award.**
 
• The list of persons announced for the year 2020 state-level sports awards is as follows-
 
• **Eklavya Award:**
 
 
• Individual Category - Sushma Verma, Kayaking-Canoeing (Sehore), Tushita Singh, Soft Tennis (Bhopal), Sparsh Khare, Wushu (Jabalpur), Arjun Singh, Horse Riding (Bhopal), Sunil Davar, Athletics (Barwani), Gauranshi Sharma, Badminton (Divyang) (Bhopal), Rammilan Yadav, Sailing (Tikamgarh), Ankit Sharma, Fencing (Gwalior), Anuradha Ahirwar, Archery (Bhopal), Preeti Rajak, Shooting (Hoshangabad), Shashank Patel, Taekwondo (Bhopal).
 
• Group Category – Sadhna Sengar, Hockey (Hoshangabad) and Dhruvraj Kurre, Powerlifting (Bhopal).
 
 
 
• **Vikram Award:**
 
 
• Individual Category - Vishwajit Singh, Canoe-Slalom (Hoshangabad), Sunidhi Chauhan, Shooting (Bhopal), Nidhi Nanhet, Karate (Balaghat), Paridhi Joshi, Horse Riding (Indore), Manju Bamboria, Boxing (Ujjain), Ekta Yadav, Sailing (Bhopal). Party Sports - Vivek Sagar Prasad, Hockey (Hoshangabad), Harshvardhan Tomar, Basketball (Gwalior), Pooja Malviya, Mallakhamb (Ujjain).
 
• Divyang Category - Prachi Yadav, Para Canoe (Gwalior).
 
 
 
• **Vishwamitra Award:**
 
 
• Individual Category – Virendra Dabas, Para Swimming and Para Athletics (Gwalior) and Richpal Singh Salaria, Archery (Jabalpur).
 
• Group Category - Dr. Habib Hassan is involved.
 
• Lifetime Achievement Award: Abhay Chhajlani, Padma Shri, and former President Indore Table Tennis Association.
 
 
 
• Late Prabhas Joshi Sports Award: Vaishnavi Kahar, Mallakhamb (Ujjain).
